# CURRENT_STATE Template

> Purpose: a ≤ 1-page status extract so a new session becomes workable fast, replacing a full re-read of long context packs.
> Part of the [Token Efficiency & Context Budget Baseline](../guides/TOKEN_EFFICIENCY_AND_CONTEXT_BUDGET_BASELINE.md) (NDF-WP-152). Additive, docs-only.

```text
Keep this file short.
Do not duplicate completed history.
Reference stable NDF rules instead of repeating them.
Escalate context budget when scope, safety, release, ADR, privacy or compatibility risk increases.
```

## Template

```text
Project:
NDF version:
Current phase:
Active WP:
Last decision:
Open blockers:
Relevant files:
Next gate:
Do not start:
Compact status:
```

## Notes

- One page maximum. If it grows past a page, it is drifting into a context pack — trim it back.
- It does **not** replace a check of the current files, the public quality gate, or human review.
- No secrets, no private data, no private project names or domains.
